senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. מוּר)to exchange, buy. Denom. מוֹהַר.

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 97a:6">Sabb. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>מְמַהֶרֶת לבוא וכ׳</he> comes quicker than &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 93a">B. Kam. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>מְמַהֲרִין לצועק וכ׳</he> he who cries for revenge will sooner be punished than he who is cried against.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 277:1">Sifré Deut. 277</cite> <he>מְמַהֵר אני ליפרע ע״י עני</he> I (the Lord) will sooner take revenge when a poor man is wronged than when a rich man is; a. fr.
